title: CHX-LIFT function dump — schema v1
description: Contract for DumpFuncs.java (Ghidra 12.2 postScript) output. Strict: any deviation means quarantine, never ingest. Producer is deterministic; drift = corruption, not style.

name.description: function name as recovered (mangled ok — enrich lane renames later)

addr.description: entry-point virtual address (image base relative offset)

bytes.description: function body size in addressable units

sig.description: Ghidra signature string, may be empty

body.description: pseudo-C decompilation; empty when decompile failed (timeout/guards)
